headline: ON THE
HARDWOOD.
hero.intro: Forty years of pickup runs, practice drills and Sunday league battles. We keep the game honest, and we keep it ours.
hero.caption: Courtside, 2025 season opener

about.intro: Founded in 1985 in a borrowed gym with two borrowed balls, the club has grown into one of the university's steadiest sporting communities — still student-run, still showing up early.
paragraphs: We are a competitive club, not a varsity program, and that is exactly the point. Every season starts with open tryouts, every lineup is earned at practice, and every member pays dues that go straight back into travel, kit and court time.
The club runs two squads — a competitive side in the regional university league and a development side for newer players — plus open gym sessions that are open to any student, member or not.

Off the court we run coaching clinics for local schools, host an alumni game every homecoming, and keep a seat at the table for anyone who has ever worn the shirt. Once you're in the club, you're in it for good.
